name: ratio
description: Ratio — AI-native FinOps platform that governs AI workload spend by measuring value, not just cost.

scripts.test:db: vitest run --config vitest.db.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.db.serial.config.ts
scripts.worker:build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-worker',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/ingest/db/migrations','dist-worker/ingest/db/migrations',{recursive:true})" && node -e "let sha=null;try{sha=require('child_process').execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim()}catch(e){}require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-worker/ingest/build-info.json',JSON.stringify({gitSha:sha,builtAt:new Date().toISOString()})+'\\n')"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run -s worker:build && node dist-worker/ingest/cli.js migrate
